senses.definition: An organized practice to prepare occupants of an office, school or other public building for evacuation in the event of a fire.
senses.example: There was a fire drill this morning. We had to leave the building calmly and go to the birch tree, our meeting point.

senses.definition: Any pointless, unproductive, useless, or chaotic activity.
senses.example: Since they've changed the standards again, our previous efforts now just amount to a fire drill.

senses.definition: A fire-starting tool consisting of a wooden rod and some primitive means of rapidly rotating the rod on a flat surface like a drill until tinder can be ignited.
